module: imgui debug window "Rally Loop Debug" (Loop Toolbox) for the rally loop, opened by gameplay_rallyLoop.toggleDebug(). It lets you pick a `rallyLoop` mission of the current level, load or unload it (gameplay_rallyLoop.setup/unload), skip the countdown or the road section (Skip), move the clock forward or back by ±10 s and ±1 min, pause the clock, and displays validation, proximity data, mission indices, distances, durations, penalties and the schedule. The drawing options (route, labels, z on top, signboards, debug info) are saved in `/settings/rally/loopToolbox.json`. The module returns a constructor: `require(...)()`.
notes: The Skip button is only active if manager:canSkip(); it emits the onGameplayInteract hook.
The "Vehicle BB" and "Leading Point" checkboxes are commented out in the interface, but the drawVehBB and drawLeadingPoint fields are still saved.
The rally signboards are scene objects whose shapeName contains `s_rally_signboard_`; findSignboards locates them and drawSignboardsDebug writes their name above them.

C.desc: Rally loop tools window. Main fields: missionDropdownItems, selectedMissionIndex, selectedMissionId, selectedMissionDir, drawRoute, drawLabels, drawZOnTop, drawSignboards, drawVehBB, drawLeadingPoint, showDebugInfo (imgui BoolPtr), signboards, syncedManager.

init.desc: Constructor: initializes the options, loads the saved settings and the mission list.

saveSettings.desc: Writes the chosen mission and the drawing options to /settings/rally/loopToolbox.json.

loadSettings.desc: Rereads this file and applies the options; if the file is absent, creates default settings all set to false. Looks for the signboards if their display was enabled.

applyManagerDrawFlags.desc: Passes the showDebugInfo option to the loop manager (setDrawFlag) and remembers this manager as synced.

refreshMissionList.desc: Fills the dropdown with the rallyLoop missions of the current level ("Name (id)") and selects the saved mission if it exists.

getSelectedMissionId.desc: Id of the mission chosen in the menu (extracted from "Name (id)").

findSignboards.desc: Looks in the scene for the rally signboards and stores them in self.signboards, with their position, shapeName and `flag` dynamic field.

formatDuration.desc: Formats a duration as [h:]mm:ss (or with tenths).

drawValidation.desc: Displays the schedule's validation problems (blocking ones in red, others in orange) or "Validation: OK".

returns.desc: true if there is a blocking problem or if the schedule is invalid.

draw.desc: Draws the whole content of the window (to be called between im.Begin and im.End).

manager.desc: Active RallyLoopManager; without a manager, only the loading part is displayed.

drawDebug.desc: 3D debug drawing: delegates to gameplay_rallyLoop.drawDebug with the zOnTop, route and labels options.

drawSignboardsDebug.desc: Draws the short name of each signboard found above its position (debugDrawer:drawTextAdvanced).
